## Using this website

You're welcome to browse and share links to this website. The text, cover art and other content on it belong to us or to our authors and artists, and you may not copy or reuse them without permission, except for short quotations in reviews.

We try to keep the information on this website accurate, but book details, availability and prices can change.

## Buying from Amazon and other retailers

Some buttons on this website take you to Amazon or other retailers. If you buy there, your contract is with that retailer, and its terms, prices, delivery and returns policies apply, not ours.

## Selling directly

We don't currently sell books or other goods directly from this website. If we start, we'll add the terms that apply to those sales here first.

## Disputes

If you have a problem with this website, please contact us first and we'll do our best to put it right. These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales. You can bring proceedings in the courts of England and Wales, or, if you live in Scotland or Northern Ireland, in the courts of where you live.
